page.layout: One page of text in a single centred column of italic Latin verse; no running head, no page number, no margin notes. Catchword "Quos" at the lower right.

main_text.p:
Divinitatis Archymista divinæ,
Non simplici stupendus arte detexis?

Seclo tamen debere pergit & fama
Sublimis illa & ambulare per doctas
Mens sueta curas, nesciisque mentiri
Per cuncta Libri: discutitque, & ex sacri
Anquirit usque latifundiis agri
Tot ruderatum opinionibus Verum,
Coloribus tot innatantibus sparsum,
Scintillulasque fenerat novæ luci
Jam fumeratas: nec nigrante defossa
Aurei talenta pectoris tegit cryptâ
Sed paginâ benigniore plus uni
Transscripta donat seculo. Illicet præsens
Toti orbis auditorio labor surgit,
Jamque in celebri se recens die jactat,
Quo Christianæ scita plebis, & nuda
Publicaque verba, Scriptor, & fidem casta
Antiquitatis sequeris, ut præit simplex
Deoque digna Religio, nec infausto
Paratragœdiata Veritas fuco.
Heic hospitalis illa portio ingentis,
Quem possides, Dei, ingeniqué inexhausti
Vegens acumen, & sacrum eloquî pondus
Se prædicandis oppido explicant signis,
Dum mentis illud igneà entheum lumen
Toto theatro spargis, immerentique
Tot expetenda dogmata imputat ævo,
Multum disertis expedita pagellis.

Agnosce Lector, æstimaque, non-lentè
Orbe erudito se quod approbat, tanti
Tam luculentum munus instar Auctoris.
Non somnia his imaginosa, non nugæ
Chartis laboriosæ inambulant, quales
Sicci solentes litoris legunt nautæ
Bullas sonoras, quasve nubium auriga
Ventosiores, ut poplo palam vendant,
Nebulas sequuntur. Non nuces vides cassas,
Adfaniasve, pectorisve fastosos
Vapidi tumultus, qualibus cerebrosi
Libros amant implere Phantasi curis,

page.notes: Catchword "Quos" at lower right, printed below the last line. Some ink specks on the scan were ignored. Long s rendered as s; æ, œ kept as printed. Uncertain readings in italic display face: "Seclo", "Jam fumeratas", "Paratragœdiata", "Vegens acumen" and "Dum mentis" were transcribed as best read.
